Thanks for confirming, the Hammer BC04 it is.

A colleague is picking this up today and sending you a payment link for the $111.68 difference ($249.00 for the BC04, less the $137.32 you paid for the GekkoAxe GT). You don't need to do anything until that lands in your inbox.

Hi Nathan,

Thanks for following up, and sorry you had to.

Two things on my side. The return that was checked in this week is your Hammer DC08, which landed at our Chattanooga warehouse on November 5. The G. box, reference Shop···· on UPS (number hidden), is still showing as not yet received there, so I've asked the warehouse to go and look for it. If it was delivered, it is sitting in receiving waiting to be booked in, and that gets sorted out at their end, not yours.

The second thing is on us. You asked how to pay the $111.68 difference for the Hammer BC04 nine days ago and no payment link reached you. A colleague is picking that up today and sending it to this address. As soon as it is settled your BC04 is reserved, and it goes out once the GekkoAxe is booked in with us.

I'll come back to you as soon as the warehouse confirms the box.

Best,
Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
